study.question: Did the random learned coordinate maps confound the prior table-storage test, and can an aligned low-rank initialization retain the unchanged source click AUC with fewer parameters and measured inference cost?
study.hypothesis: The previous square16 projection lost 0.0023333483684966 click AUC despite retaining full table and interaction width, so raw storage insufficiency cannot explain that contrast alone. Random field rotations change the inherited coordinatewise query-key product and optimizer geometry. Starting the same trainable maps at identity (16->16) or duplicated coordinate axes [I8; I8] (8->16), while preserving their singular spectrum and all other initialized parameters, may remove an initialization penalty and expose a more favorable compact quality/cost point. This is a discriminating follow-up to an unsuccessful factorization, not a novel-architecture claim. Global norm preservation does not establish coordinate-product preservation for random rotations, and the hypothesis is unconfirmed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary text inspected at lines 219-279: target-conditioned local activation and unnormalized weighted pooling are inherited ideas. Our actual scorer uses concatenated q,k,q-k,q*k plus historical action, 30 precompressed UF slots and gated four-task training. This study only changes the initial geometry of a bias-free storage-to-interaction map; no exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Direct nearest local implementation: identical 8-wide tables, 16-wide interactions, 16,166,277 parameters, source gradient gates and learned bias-free maps. Only overwrite the random initialized maps with [I8; I8] after consuming the identical random draws.

Nearest full-capacity control: same square map architecture and 32,065,317 parameters. Initialize at identity instead of orthogonal rotation. The additional learned maps remain present; this differs from the unchanged 32,060,453-parameter source.

The audited primary benchmark section describes Zenith separate identifier capacity and UniMixer flattened chunk tokenization. Neither is adopted. Original method records are link-only and their full papers were not audited; no stronger novelty or reproduction claim is made.

study.proposed_difference: A matched initialization intervention in the existing factorized model: each full-rank map starts as I16, each compact map as vertical [I8; I8]; all maps remain trainable. Copy the ancestors byte-for-byte for two random-map replay controls. Use a 2x2 table rank (8/16) by initial geometry (aligned/random) comparison. No new inputs, loss, heads, optimizer settings, projection placement or inference operators. All four cells are standalone modules. This is optimization/attribution research; it is not itself a new modeling contribution.
predictions: At initialization the identity16 variant should have source-equivalent embeddings, scorer/tower parameters, forward predictions and Dice persistent-state updates at matched input/state (FP32 exact or tight tolerance, BF16 tolerance reported); it need not have an identical training trajectory after a step because the maps are trainable.

Within each rank, aligned/random variants should have identical non-projection initial state and final RNG state; maps should differ but share singular values. The compact map has rank 8, P^T P=2I and all output rows initially nonzero. Its output correlations differ from the random map.

Identity16 should improve validation click AUC over random16 if harmful random basis geometry is consequential under the one-pass recipe. Aligned8 should improve over random8 if the effect transfers to the compact representation; this is not guaranteed by the square result.

Capacity is unchanged within geometry contrasts: expect 16,166,277 total / 15,896,608 embedding / 269,669 dense parameters for each compact map and 32,065,317 / 31,793,216 / 272,101 for each full map. Verify host counts and alias ownership.

Initialization alone adds no inference operator, so aligned/random timing at a given rank should be comparable. Any compact-versus-source speed benefit must be measured rather than inferred from the roughly 50% parameter reduction.

All current validation results must cover 2,871,767 samples and report click plus all auxiliary task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, training/allocated GPU cost, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95. Source auxiliary mean is weak and must remain visible; click retention alone is not four-task retention.
falsifiers: Any numerical input/masking, gradient-routing, initialization parity, optimizer-ownership or state-update check fails: classify as an implementation/gate failure and repair only under an explicitly recorded charged attempt; never interpret it as scientific counterevidence.
Identity16 fails to recover any of the random16 deficit: the simple initial-rotation explanation is not supported, though trainable-map optimization remains an alternative.
Aligned8 fails the predeclared source click-AUC margin, parameter gate or measured latency gate: this implementation does not establish the proposed efficiency benefit.

An aligned advantage disappears under later authorized paired seeds, contemporaneous source timing, or matched compute: robust retention remains unestablished. No seed changes are permitted through model CONFIG.
A result improves only versus random projection but remains worse than the unchanged source beyond margin: report a rescued parameterization, not preserved source quality.
alternative_explanations: All earlier reduced candidates lost AUC: source replay 0.660646940486458; direct embedding8 0.6577818495793547; dense-half 0.6594732894200026; both-half 0.6581939949883804. Capacity may be genuinely needed under the frozen recipe. These are unsuccessful efficiency trajectories, not runtime failures.

Previous projected results were also lower: table8/interaction16 0.6587804634476035; table16/interaction8 0.6587156598975485; square8 0.6575813271035839; square16 0.6583135921179614. All four succeeded in execution; square-map optimization effects obstruct a storage-only causal interpretation.
Learnable projections add dense AdamW dynamics and change the sparse Adagrad coordinate system; identity does not remove the extra optimization path.

Dice batch normalization, changed marginal coordinate scale/correlation, downstream linear feature basis and elementwise product geometry can jointly explain a benefit. This study identifies initialization geometry, not one unique pathway.
A single fixed seed, validation selection and historical reference timing can exaggerate apparent quality/cost retention. Replays of an identical seed are consistency/cost controls only.

The inherited offline feedback visibility and publisher static snapshots do not establish production point-in-time validity. Auxiliary labels remain category/brand future matches rather than ad-specific attribution.

host_checks: Before training, verify pinned data/source/protocol identities against existing accepted receipts; no new readiness success is asserted by preparation.

Instantiate all four cells on the authorized host. Verify output keys, [B,1] probabilities, finite forward/backward for singleton and regular batches, label isolation, target-action nonuse, all-empty/mixed/full histories and padded-history/aux-mask perturbation invariance.

Compare aligned/random initial state_dict and RNG states at each rank: only projection weights may differ. Audit actual table aliases, no duplicate optimizer assignment, trainable dense projections under AdamW and original embedding weights under Adagrad.

Check square identity initial predictions/interactions and primary Dice state against the unchanged source at matched seed/state in training and eval modes. No claim of equality after an optimizer step. Check primary scorer updates Dice persistent state once; auxiliary functional scorer updates only cloned buffers.

Check compact P^T P=2I and full P^T P=I, plus nonzero compact output-row norms. Verify projection-before/after masked means within FP32/BF16 tolerances. Compact maps must remain trainable, including initially zero elements.

Separately backpropagate each task: auxiliary losses update context and their towers but neither item/action tables/maps nor scorer parameters; click updates its complete source path. Audit shared-table aliases before making group ownership claims.
Count parameter ownership and measure host full-data train/inference costs. Do not claim numerical gates pass from AST or pure-Python algebra. All gate checks/retries consume the actual ledger.

local_observations_for_append.observation: Both uniform capacity reductions and all four learned projection variants lost click AUC relative to the unchanged source. No current efficiency-retention success. The square16 result changes trainable parameterization without reducing rank, so it does not isolate capacity shortage.
local_observations_for_append.limitation: Single seed; no withheld outcomes. Repeated source execution is reproducibility evidence, not independent replication.
local_observations_for_append.revision: Previous usage declared storage/interaction disentanglement, but the full-width learned-map deficit limits that interpretation. The current initial-geometry explanation is a prospective hypothesis, not controlled support.
local_observations_for_append.storage_status: Recorded in this authorized proposal artifact for host append to scoped memory; read-only evidence.jsonl is not edited and no separate memory-write interface is available.

selection_policy.interpretation: Engineering screening margin, not a confidence bound or proof of noninferiority. Full suite and seeds must be frozen before withheld assessment. Auxiliary degradation remains reported even when click gate passes.
selection_policy.cost_gate: Fewer total parameters and at least 5% lower model-only p50 and p95 latency against unchanged source; initial historical timing comparison is provisional until contemporaneous replay. Report end-to-end throughput separately.
